summary: Deep Affliction with Wrack as the main spell, channelled back to back while Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast under it, with Soul Siphon and Shadow Mastery, the Imp sacrificed for 15% Shadow damage and no demon out.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5s (lands just after the pull)
Racials on cooldown, except Troll Berserking
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Bane of Agony when it is down, with more than 12s left (no Bane of Doom: Wrack speeds up Agony's ticks, not Doom's one tick)
Corruption when it is down or has less than 2.5s left, with more than 3s left
Immolate when it is down or ends within its cast time, with more than 15s left
Death Coil, then Searing Pain, when the filler would not land before the fight ends
Troll Berserking right before a Shadow Bolt, so the haste goes on cast spells, not instants
Siphon Life when it is down
Wrack whenever nothing above it is due: while it channels, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast
Shadow Bolt as the filler (in practice only the pre-pull cast: Wrack takes every free GCD)
caveats: Wrack's numbers are server hotfix 113766's (60.2 a second at 60, 0.2002 coefficient). How its 100% faster ticks time against the damage over time spells is our reading of the developers' note (the tick timer runs twice as fast while Wrack channels and keeps its progress after; no partial tick when a spell runs out); a log would confirm it.

Bane of Agony steps up every 4 ticks and stays at 150% past its 12th tick (the extra ticks Wrack gives). If its steps instead followed the 8 s thirds of its duration, this build would lose about 11 DPS.
Shadow Bolt Affliction (warlock__affliction_shadow_bolt, the Succubus out) is 62 DPS behind at 180 s (1015.1 against 1076.9, after hotfix 113766).
Bane of Doom's coefficient is 4.0 (Era has 1.0). At 2.0, Shadow Bolt builds would lose about 4%. At 1.0, about 6%.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Shadow Bolt stops at rank IX, Immolate at VII and Corruption at VI. The books would add 7 to 13 DPS.
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is active. The 5-piece added about 8 to 13 DPS on an older gear set.
Soul shards and Life Tap's health cost aren't tracked.
